chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn ʿĪsā, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr, from ʿAbdullāh ibn Yaḥyā al-Kāhilī, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
If blood or something else comes out from the nostril of the deceased after the ghusl and it reaches the turban or the shroud, it should be cut away with scissors.

key_terms.الْعِمَامَةَ: the turban cloth used in the burial wrapping
key_terms.الْغُسْلِ: the ritual washing of the deceased
key_terms.قُرِضَ: it is to be cut off or clipped away

ai.seo_question: What should be done if blood comes from the deceased after the ghusl and stains the kafan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling regarding the deceased after the ghusl. If blood or another discharge emerges from the nose and soils the wrapping cloth, the affected portion of the turban or shroud is to be cut away.
